description: Precision comparison of ST-MoE, CSTP, and Random Control across workloads
main_conclusion: Real traces yield up to 29.1% precision vs 3.1% on random control

description: Prediction and update latency in microseconds
main_conclusion: Predictor overhead is < 36 microseconds per stage (< 0.16% host overhead)

description: Timely resident hits scaling as on-chip computation window expands
main_conclusion: Timely hits emerge at M>=4 and double at M>=12

description: Exposed memory stall reduction scaling with compute multiplier
main_conclusion: Stall reduction scales from 0 ms at M=1 up to 12.86 ms at M=16

description: Cache pollution comparison between Standard LRU and PABI Quarantine
main_conclusion: PABI reduces demand cache pollution events to exactly 0

description: Comparative exposed memory stall across baseline and prefetch variants
main_conclusion: PF-C achieves lowest exposed stall (244,128.85 ms, 945.92 ms reduction)

description: Execution time and MoE stall across prefill context length (128 to 2048)
main_conclusion: Context length increases attention runtime but MoE expert stall remains identical

description: Prediction precision as lookahead horizon increases from H=1 to H=3
main_conclusion: H=2 provides optimal trade-off between transfer lead time and precision

description: Estimated DDR5 transport energy across candidate budgets B=1, 2, 4
main_conclusion: Throttling from B=4 to B=1 reduces speculative transport energy by 77.7%

description: Comparison of ST-MoE F1 score between real recorded traces and random control
main_conclusion: Real traces yield 6x to 8.7x higher prediction quality than random routing
